//go:build integration
// +build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/migrations"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

const (
	studentMigrationTestURL   = "STUDENT_MIGRATIONS_TEST_DATABASE_URL"
	studentMigrationTestReset = "STUDENT_MIGRATIONS_TEST_ALLOW_SCHEMA_RESET"
	studentMigrationLockName  = "ms-go-student-migrations-v1"
)

// This opt-in suite drops and recreates public. The target database must be
// disposable and end in _migration_test; the second explicit opt-in prevents
// an accidental reset from a merely configured URL.
func TestStudentMigrationRunnerPostgresIntegration(t *testing.T) {
	databaseURL := studentMigrationTestDatabaseURL(t)

	t.Run("fresh_schema_full_migration_replay_and_lock_release", func(t *testing.T) {
		resetStudentMigrationSchema(t, databaseURL)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
		defer cancel()

		runner := newStudentMigrationRunner(t, ctx, databaseURL, studentMigrationDirectory())
		defer runner.Close()
		completed, err := runner.Up(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("apply fresh Student migrations: %v", err)
		}
		status, err := runner.Status(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("read migrated status: %v", err)
		}
		if status.Applied != status.Available || len(completed) != status.Available {
			t.Fatalf("fresh status = %+v, newly applied = %d", status, len(completed))
		}
		assertMigration016Postcondition(t, ctx, databaseURL)

		replayed, err := runner.Up(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("replay completed migrations: %v", err)
		}
		if len(replayed) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("replay applied %d migrations, want none", len(replayed))
		}
		assertStudentMigrationLockReleased(t, ctx, databaseURL)
	})

	t.Run("checksum_gap_and_unknown_history_fail_closed", func(t *testing.T) {
		for _, testCase := range []struct {
			name   string
			mutate func(context.Context, *pgx.Conn) error
		}{
			{
				name: "checksum",
				mutate: func(ctx context.Context, conn *pgx.Conn) error {
					_, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE student_schema_migrations SET sha256 = $1 WHERE filename = '001_first.sql'`, strings.Repeat("0", 64))
					return err
				},
			},
			{
				name: "gap",
				mutate: func(ctx context.Context, conn *pgx.Conn) error {
					_, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM student_schema_migrations WHERE filename = '001_first.sql'`)
					return err
				},
			},
			{
				name: "unknown",
				mutate: func(ctx context.Context, conn *pgx.Conn) error {
					_, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO student_schema_migrations (filename, sha256) VALUES ('999_unknown.sql', $1)`, strings.Repeat("a", 64))
					return err
				},
			},
		} {
			t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
				resetStudentMigrationSchema(t, databaseURL)
				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
				defer cancel()
				runner := newStudentMigrationRunner(t, ctx, databaseURL, writeStudentMigrationFixtures(t))
				defer runner.Close()
				if applied, err := runner.Up(ctx); err != nil || len(applied) != 2 {
					t.Fatalf("seed fixture migrations: applied=%v err=%v", applied, err)
				}
				conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
				defer conn.Close(ctx)
				if err := testCase.mutate(ctx, conn); err != nil {
					t.Fatalf("corrupt migration history: %v", err)
				}
				if _, err := runner.Up(ctx); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("runner accepted invalid migration history")
				}
				assertStudentMigrationLockReleased(t, ctx, databaseURL)
			})
		}
	})

	t.Run("nonempty_schema_without_history_is_refused", func(t *testing.T) {
		resetStudentMigrationSchema(t, databaseURL)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
		if _, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `CREATE TABLE retained_student_data (id integer PRIMARY KEY)`); err != nil {
			conn.Close(ctx)
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO retained_student_data VALUES (7)`); err != nil {
			conn.Close(ctx)
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		conn.Close(ctx)

		runner := newStudentMigrationRunner(t, ctx, databaseURL, writeStudentMigrationFixtures(t))
		defer runner.Close()
		if _, err := runner.Up(ctx); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "refusing to adopt") {
			t.Fatalf("nonempty untracked schema error = %v", err)
		}
		assertStudentMigrationLockReleased(t, ctx, databaseURL)
		assertStudentMigrationTableCount(t, ctx, databaseURL, "retained_student_data", 1)
	})

	t.Run("empty_history_with_existing_schema_is_refused", func(t *testing.T) {
		resetStudentMigrationSchema(t, databaseURL)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
		_, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `CREATE TABLE student_schema_migrations (filename text PRIMARY KEY, sha256 char(64) NOT NULL, applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())`)
		if err == nil {
			_, err = conn.Exec(ctx, `CREATE TABLE retained_student_data (id integer PRIMARY KEY)`)
		}
		conn.Close(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}

		runner := newStudentMigrationRunner(t, ctx, databaseURL, writeStudentMigrationFixtures(t))
		defer runner.Close()
		if _, err := runner.Up(ctx); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "ledger is empty") {
			t.Fatalf("empty-ledger existing schema error = %v", err)
		}
		assertStudentMigrationLockReleased(t, ctx, databaseURL)
		assertStudentMigrationTableCount(t, ctx, databaseURL, "retained_student_data", 0)
	})

	t.Run("explicit_transaction_failure_rolls_back_schema_and_ledger", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Run("migration_sql_failure", func(t *testing.T) {
			resetStudentMigrationSchema(t, databaseURL)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			directory := t.TempDir()
			writeMigrationFile(t, directory, "001_failing.sql", `BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE rollback_probe (id integer PRIMARY KEY);
SELECT 1 / 0;
COMMIT;
`)
			runner := newStudentMigrationRunner(t, ctx, databaseURL, directory)
			defer runner.Close()
			if _, err := runner.Up(ctx); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected explicit-transaction migration failure")
			}
			assertStudentMigrationLockReleased(t, ctx, databaseURL)
			conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
			defer conn.Close(ctx)
			var historyExists, probeExists bool
			if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass('public.student_schema_migrations') IS NOT NULL, to_regclass('public.rollback_probe') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&historyExists, &probeExists); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if historyExists || probeExists {
				t.Fatalf("failed migration left schema split: ledger=%t probe=%t", historyExists, probeExists)
			}
		})

		t.Run("checksum_insert_failure", func(t *testing.T) {
			resetStudentMigrationSchema(t, databaseURL)
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
			_, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `CREATE TABLE student_schema_migrations (filename text PRIMARY KEY CHECK (filename <> '001_checksum_fails.sql'), sha256 char(64) NOT NULL, applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())`)
			conn.Close(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			directory := t.TempDir()
			writeMigrationFile(t, directory, "001_checksum_fails.sql", `BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE checksum_failure_probe (id integer PRIMARY KEY);
COMMIT;
`)
			runner := newStudentMigrationRunner(t, ctx, databaseURL, directory)
			defer runner.Close()
			if _, err := runner.Up(ctx); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected migration ledger insert failure")
			}
			assertStudentMigrationLockReleased(t, ctx, databaseURL)
			conn = connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
			defer conn.Close(ctx)
			var ledgerRows int
			var probeExists bool
			if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_schema_migrations`).Scan(&ledgerRows); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass('public.checksum_failure_probe') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&probeExists); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if ledgerRows != 0 || probeExists {
				t.Fatalf("checksum failure left SQL/ledger split: ledger rows=%d probe=%t", ledgerRows, probeExists)
			}
		})
	})

	t.Run("two_runners_serialize_and_release_session_lock", func(t *testing.T) {
		resetStudentMigrationSchema(t, databaseURL)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		directory := t.TempDir()
		writeMigrationFile(t, directory, "001_serialized.sql", `CREATE TABLE migration_serialization_probe (id integer PRIMARY KEY);
INSERT INTO migration_serialization_probe (id) VALUES (1);
SELECT pg_sleep(0.5);
`)
		first := newStudentMigrationRunner(t, ctx, databaseURL, directory)
		defer first.Close()
		second := newStudentMigrationRunner(t, ctx, databaseURL, directory)
		defer second.Close()

		start := make(chan struct{})
		type result struct {
			applied []string
			err     error
		}
		results := make(chan result, 2)
		var workers sync.WaitGroup
		for _, runner := range []*migrations.Runner{first, second} {
			workers.Add(1)
			go func(runner *migrations.Runner) {
				defer workers.Done()
				<-start
				applied, err := runner.Up(ctx)
				results <- result{applied: applied, err: err}
			}(runner)
		}
		close(start)
		workers.Wait()
		close(results)
		totalApplied := 0
		for item := range results {
			if item.err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("concurrent Up failed: %v", item.err)
			}
			totalApplied += len(item.applied)
		}
		if totalApplied != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("concurrent runners applied %d migrations, want exactly one", totalApplied)
		}
		assertStudentMigrationTableCount(t, ctx, databaseURL, "migration_serialization_probe", 1)
		assertStudentMigrationLockReleased(t, ctx, databaseURL)
	})
}

func studentMigrationTestDatabaseURL(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	databaseURL := os.Getenv(studentMigrationTestURL)
	if databaseURL == "" || os.Getenv(studentMigrationTestReset) != "1" {
		t.Skipf("set %s and %s=1 to opt into the destructive disposable-database migration test", studentMigrationTestURL, studentMigrationTestReset)
	}
	config, err := pgx.ParseConfig(databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse migration test database URL: %v", err)
	}
	if !isLoopbackPostgresTestURL(databaseURL) || !isAllowedLoopbackTestHost(config.Host) {
		t.Fatalf("refusing schema reset for non-loopback PostgreSQL host; use 127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1")
	}
	if !strings.HasSuffix(config.Database, "_migration_test") {
		t.Fatalf("refusing schema reset for database %q; database name must end in _migration_test", config.Database)
	}
	return databaseURL
}

func studentMigrationDirectory() string {
	return filepath.Join("..", "..", "db", "migrations")
}

func newStudentMigrationRunner(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, databaseURL, directory string) *migrations.Runner {
	t.Helper()
	runner, err := migrations.New(ctx, databaseURL, directory)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create migration runner: %v", err)
	}
	return runner
}

func resetStudentMigrationSchema(t *testing.T, databaseURL string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
	defer conn.Close(ctx)
	if _, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE`); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("drop disposable public schema: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `CREATE SCHEMA public`); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("recreate disposable public schema: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO CURRENT_USER`); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("grant disposable public schema access: %v", err)
	}
}

func connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, databaseURL string) *pgx.Conn {
	t.Helper()
	conn, err := pgx.Connect(ctx, databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect disposable migration test database: %v", err)
	}
	return conn
}

func assertMigration016Postcondition(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, databaseURL string) {
	t.Helper()
	conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
	defer conn.Close(ctx)
	var ledgerRows, onboardingRows int
	var onboardingTableExists bool
	if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM student_schema_migrations WHERE filename = '016_student_onboarding.sql'),
       (SELECT count(*) FROM student_onboarding),
       (SELECT to_regclass('public.student_onboarding') IS NOT NULL)
`).Scan(&ledgerRows, &onboardingRows, &onboardingTableExists); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read migration 016 postcondition: %v", err)
	}
	if ledgerRows != 1 || onboardingRows != 0 || !onboardingTableExists {
		t.Fatalf("migration 016 postcondition = ledger rows %d, onboarding rows %d, table exists %t", ledgerRows, onboardingRows, onboardingTableExists)
	}
}

func assertStudentMigrationLockReleased(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, databaseURL string) {
	t.Helper()
	conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
	defer conn.Close(ctx)
	var acquired bool
	if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT pg_try_advisory_lock(hashtext($1))`, studentMigrationLockName).Scan(&acquired); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("probe migration lock release: %v", err)
	}
	if !acquired {
		t.Fatal("migration session advisory lock remained held")
	}
	if _, err := conn.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(hashtext($1))`, studentMigrationLockName); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("release migration lock probe: %v", err)
	}
}

func assertStudentMigrationTableCount(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, databaseURL, table string, expected int) {
	t.Helper()
	conn := connectStudentMigrationTestDB(t, ctx, databaseURL)
	defer conn.Close(ctx)
	query := fmt.Sprintf(`SELECT count(*) FROM %s`, pgx.Identifier{table}.Sanitize())
	var count int
	if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, query).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("count rows in %s: %v", table, err)
	}
	if count != expected {
		t.Fatalf("%s rows = %d, want %d", table, count, expected)
	}
}

func writeStudentMigrationFixtures(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	directory := t.TempDir()
	writeMigrationFile(t, directory, "001_first.sql", `CREATE TABLE migration_fixture_first (id integer PRIMARY KEY);`)
	writeMigrationFile(t, directory, "002_second.sql", `CREATE TABLE migration_fixture_second (id integer PRIMARY KEY);`)
	return directory
}

func writeMigrationFile(t *testing.T, directory, filename, contents string) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, filename), []byte(contents), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write migration fixture: %v", err)
	}
}
